about_the_game:
A mystery puzzle game that you want to play through in one evening!

Step into the eerie elegance of Hotel Luximinal, where every corridor tells a story and every corner hides a secret. This is no ordinary hotel. Strange occurrences, shifting objects, and unexplainable anomalies await your discovery. Will you solve the mystery of the disturbances, or be consumed by the hotel forever?

7 Levels with Mysterious Charm

  • Hotel Hallway

  • Private Poolroom

  • Hotel Gallery

  • Waiting Rooms

  • Midnight Dining Hall

  • Vintage 1925 Office

  • Secret Suite

What to Expect:

  • Discover the Hidden: Spot anomalies – subtle, surreal changes that challenge your perception. From vanishing vases to disturbing distortions in decor, every detail counts.

  • Explore Unique Levels: Immerse yourself in 7 atmospheric environments, from opulent Art Deco lobbies to surreal pool chambers. Each level tells its own story with distinct challenges and secrets.

Find all 210 Anomalies!

  • 30 anomalies in each of the 7 levels

  • Some are easy to spot

  • Others are trickier

  • Take your time to memorize everything

  • Levels get harder as you progress

  • Be careful, or you might get trapped forever!

Each correct choice brings you one floor higher. Get it right 7 times and return to the lobby.

The Rules Are Simple:

  • Start at floor 0

  • Upon entering: Study every detail in the room

  • Think there’s no anomaly? Enter the “other” elevator

  • Think there’s an anomaly? Return to the starting elevator

  • Correct guess: Go up one floor

  • Wrong guess: Return to floor 0

  • Guess correctly 8 times

  • Unlock the next level

  • Leave the hotel as a successful researcher for your company

Why Hotel Luximinal Is Unique:

  • Immersive Art Deco Design: A surreal blend of elegance and unease, inspired by the glamor of the 1920s.

  • Mysterious Atmosphere: Dynamic soundscapes, eerie visuals, and the constant feeling you’re not alone.

Find the Answer to the 3 Big Questions
Post your theory in the community. What do you believe happened?

  • What’s wrong with this hotel?

  • What’s the story behind those strange elevators?

  • What is the true effect of Luximinal?

Special Features:

  • Engaging single-player experience focused on detail and perception

  • Dynamic anomalies create a fresh experience with each playthrough

  • Steam Cloud support for synchronized progress

  • Achievements to reward your exploration

Bonus: The lobby features a jukebox with over 20 tracks. Enjoy the music, click through the songs, and let the atmosphere envelop you.

  • Jazz

  • Swing

  • Relaxing background music

This hotel is alive – and it’s watching you. Will you rise to the challenge, or will the anomalies claim you?

short_description: Love spotting anomalies and exploring the glamorous Art Deco of 1925 New York? Dive into Hotel Luximinal – a captivating journey through surreal rooms where the ordinary turns extraordinary. Find hidden anomalies, uncover mysteries, and immerse yourself in a world of elegance and intrigue!
